# Cook Medical

> Cook Medical manufactures minimally invasive medical devices and provides comprehensive support, training, and reimbursement resources for healthcare professionals.

Cook Medical is a global leader in medical device innovation, offering a wide range of catheter systems, surgical equipment, and vascular solutions. The company provides integrated support through platforms like Cook Vista for professional education and MyCook for customer authentication, alongside comprehensive ordering, reimbursement, and compliance resources.

## Key Topics

- Minimally invasive procedures
- Medical devices
- Catheter systems
- Vascular and surgical products
- Cook Vista education platform
- Reimbursement coding
- C-Code finder
- Product performance reporting
- BusinessCare Integration
- Capital equipment service
- Medical device training
- Healthcare professional development
- Compliance and ethics
- Supply chain standards
- MRI safety
